games.title: Star Citizen

unsupported_techs.reason: AMD FSR 2 and CIG TSR are compiled directly into StarCitizen.exe & Data.p4k shaders (no external FSR DLL in Bin64).
DLSS Frame Generation (nvngx_dlssg.dll) is not natively supported by StarEngine yet.
Ray Reconstruction (nvngx_dlssd.dll) and Intel XeSS (libxess.dll) are not natively integrated in Star Citizen.

games.warning_banner: EasyAntiCheat monitors Bin64: Only official NVIDIA-signed nvngx_dlss.dll builds (full all-presets production build) and NVIDIA Driver DRS Presets (Preset K) are supported.
recommended_settings: Upscaling: DLSS (Quality or Balanced at 1440p/4K)
NVIDIA DLSS Preset: Preset K (DLSS 4.0 mit Original-DLL v310.2.1 · DLSS 4.5 erst nach DLL-Update auf v310.9.16)
Graphics Renderer: Vulkan

games.title: Overwatch 2

unsupported_techs.reason: Overwatch 2 supports DLSS Super Resolution & Reflex, but does not ship with DLSS Frame Generation (nvngx_dlssg.dll).

games.warning_banner: Blizzard Defense Matrix: Official NVIDIA-signed nvngx_dlss.dll updates and NVIDIA Driver DRS Presets are supported. Battle.net updates may reset nvngx_dlss.dll after major patches.
recommended_settings: High Quality Upsampling: NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution (Quality)
NVIDIA Reflex: Enabled + Boost
Dynamic Render Scale: Off (for consistent crosshair sharpness)
